meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Codex 作为命令行智能体，与 Claude 并用或替代，支持工具调用与历史续接。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你 用的工具支持多智能体（如 OneCLI），想换成或搭配 OpenAI 的代码模型。
copy.tagline_en: Configure Codex as your coding agent, with tool use and session history.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use OneCLI and want to replace or pair Claude with OpenAI Codex.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 里会增加一个叫 codex 的代理后端,每个群组可切到 Codex 来规划、调用工具、使用 MCP 工具,会话历史保存在服务端、可恢复。凭证只存 OneCLI 保险库。不主动切换时仍用 Claude。
howto.when: 当操作员在主机上对某个群组执行 `ncl groups config update --provider codex` 并重启时,该组改用 Codex;也可在安装后询问是否把新群组默认设为 codex。

say.text: 把群组 123 换成 Codex 提供方
say.note: 该组会用 Codex 跑任务。

say.text: 检查 codex 是否装好
say.note: 运行验证测试并报告结果。

say.text: 重新跑 codex 鉴权,我换个 API key
say.note: 唤起登录或输 key 的流程。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw gains a "codex" agent backend. Each group can be switched to Codex for planning, tool calls, MCP tools; conversation history is stored server-side and resumable. Credentials live only in the OneCLI vault. Claude remains the default until you switch.
howto.when_en: When an operator runs `ncl groups config update --provider codex` for a group on the host and restarts it; or optionally after install when asked whether new groups should default to codex and confirmed.

say_en.text: Switch group 123 to the Codex provider.

say_en.note: Runs the validation tests and reports.

say_en.text: Re-run Codex auth with a new API key.
